browsers.no_browsers_description: Install the Asyar Companion extension below — once it's running, it pairs automatically and your browser shows up here.
browsers.companion_description: Asyar's browser features need a small companion extension installed in your browser. The two work as a pair: the companion streams your open tabs, bookmarks, and history to Asyar so you can search and control them from here. Install it, and it pairs with this launcher automatically.
browsers.install_chrome_note: Works for Chrome, Brave, Edge, Arc, and Vivaldi. Firefox and Safari companions are coming soon.

privacy.no_trusted_programs_description: When an extension runs a binary, or you approve its declared binaries at install, they will appear here.

privacy.anonymous_id_description: A random id, not linked to your account. Reset it any time.
privacy.shell_trust_description: The following programs have been explicitly trusted for execution by specific extensions. Revoking trust will cause the extension to prompt for permission again on next use.
privacy.redaction_enabled_desc: Master switch for redacting known secret formats before storage. Items still appear in history; the secret value is gone.
privacy.clipboard_items_desc: Detect and redact secrets in copied text, HTML, and RTF before storing.
privacy.snippets_desc: Detect and redact secrets in snippet expansions on save.
privacy.ai_conversations_desc: Redact user-typed messages before storing AND before sending to the AI provider.
privacy.this_session_desc: Number of redaction events since the launcher started.
privacy.active_detectors_desc: The bundled rule catalog. Updating the catalog requires a launcher update.
privacy.clipboard_privacy_desc: Asyar will not store clipboard items that the OS or source app has marked private.
privacy.clipboard_session_desc: Clipboard items skipped since the launcher started.
privacy.default_denylist_desc: Built-in password managers — always blocked, not editable.
privacy.add_bundle_id_desc: Bundle id (macOS), executable name (Windows), or .desktop id (Linux).
privacy.your_additions_desc: Apps you have added to the denylist.
privacy.crash_reports_desc: Asyar sends no telemetry by default. Opt in to help fix crashes — you choose how.
privacy.crash_ask_desc: Preview the exact report before sending.
privacy.usage_ask_desc: Show me what will be sent before sharing usage data.
privacy.usage_auto_desc: Send anonymous daily counts in the background.
privacy.encryption_desc_active: Active — your master key is stored in the OS keychain. A stolen disk image alone cannot decrypt your data.
privacy.encryption_desc_fallback: Falling back to a file-backed key because Secret Service was unavailable. Install gnome-keyring or KWallet for full at-rest protection.
privacy.encryption_desc_unavailable: The launcher is still booting or the host status command failed.
privacy.unlock_sync_desc: Encrypted sync needs your passphrase to continue.
privacy.rotate_dialog_body: Your recovery phrase will not change — only the passphrase used to unlock encrypted sync.
privacy.error_rotate_failed: Couldn't change passphrase. Check the old passphrase and try again.

onboarding.cheatsheet_desc: Keep these five shortcuts handy. You can re-run this tour anytime from Settings.
onboarding.welcome_subtitle: Meet Asyar — your keyboard-first command center
onboarding.welcome_desc: Search apps, do math, ask AI, rewrite text anywhere, expand snippets, and more — all from one box. Let's take a 2-minute tour and set you up.
onboarding.tour_appearance_desc: Light, dark, or follow your system.
onboarding.tour_window_mode_desc: Default shows results panel; Compact is just the search bar.
onboarding.tour_raycast_desc: Bring over your snippets, quicklinks, and app hotkeys.
onboarding.summon_desc: Press Option+Space from anywhere to open Asyar. Try searching an app, or do quick math — type 24 * 7 and press Enter.
onboarding.change_hotkey_hint: Prefer a different key? Change it
onboarding.theme_heading: Pick a look that fits your workspace
onboarding.theme_desc: Switch anytime from Settings (⌘,) → Appearance. Themes change the palette, contrast, and accent highlights.
onboarding.browser_desc: Asyar works with your browser to search open tabs, recent history, and bookmarks directly from the search bar.
onboarding.snippets_desc: Save a keyword and it expands into full text in any app you type in — addresses, signatures, boilerplate. Snippets can include placeholders like {clipboard} or {date}. We'll add a sample snippet.
onboarding.autostart_desc: Start Asyar silently in the background when your computer turns on, so it's instantly ready the moment you press Option+Space.
onboarding.privacy_desc: When Asyar crashes, it can send a small report so the team can fix the problem faster. You are always in control — choose what feels right for you.
onboarding.anonymous_usage_desc: Share anonymous daily counts of which commands you run. No search text, no file paths, no personal data.
onboarding.featured_desc: Install powerful add-ons created by the community. You can discover hundreds more in the Store anytime.
